name: 灰燕鴴
illustrationTaxon: Glareola lactea: 15-19 cm, a small pale grey-sandy pratincole. Dark forehead and lores, and an obvious white orbital ring that is broadest at the rear of the eye. Short bill with a deep red base. Primaries contrastingly dark greyish and the legs the same dark grey. Underparts below the chest clean white. Distinctive pattern in flight: black underwing coverts and whitish secondaries with broad grey tips, a black tail, and dark greyish upperwing primary coverts contrasting with the grey-sandy inner wing coverts. The smallest of the pratincoles and the palest, lacking the olive-brown upperparts and buff throat of Oriental Pratincole.

similarSpecies.distinction: 普通燕鴴體型大得多（23–25 公分）、背與翼是欖褐色，喉部淡黃褐並被一圈黑線圍住，嘴基紅色但整體羽色偏褐；本種小一截、整體淡灰沙色，沒有那圈黑線，靠眼後最寬的白眼圈與深灰初級飛羽辨認。
黑翅燕鴴翼上覆羽與飛羽全黑、次級飛羽沒有白色後緣，整體顏色深得多；本種翼上以淡灰沙色為主，只有初級飛羽深灰，兩者顏色深淺差很遠。

featureNotes: 嘴短、嘴基是深紅色，前端黑色；燕鴴科的嘴裂很寬，配合在空中張口捕蟲，但站著時只看得到這截深紅（第1圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
白色眼圈完整一圈、而且在眼後最寬，配上深色的額與眼先，是灰燕鴴最好認的頭部特徵；普通燕鴴沒有這圈白（第2圈取自近景圖，實際可見）。
初級飛羽是明顯較深的灰黑色，與淡灰沙色的內側翼覆羽形成對比，翼尖伸過短短的尾端（第3圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。
胸以下乾淨純白，沒有任何縱紋或淡黃褐色調；本種是燕鴴裡最小最淡的一種，白得很徹底（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

sources.use: HKBWS substantive read: Category I, accidental; 15-19 cm, a small pale grey-sandy pratincole with a dark forehead and lores and an obvious white orbital ring broadest at the rear of the eye; primaries contrastingly dark greyish and the legs the same; underparts below the chest clean white; base of the bill deep red; distinctive flight pattern of black underwing coverts and whitish secondaries with broad grey tips, black tail, and dark greyish upperwing primary coverts contrasting with grey-sandy inner wing coverts; Hong Kong's sole record was one at San Tin on 4 April 2017 at fish ponds in the northwest New Territories (Lee 2019, Hong Kong Bird Report 2017); monotypic, ranging from east Afghanistan and Pakistan through much of the Indian subcontinent to Bangladesh and east to southwest China and south through Myanmar to Thailand, Laos and Cambodia; in China regular in southeast Tibet and western/southern Yunnan and has occurred in Hainan; IUCN Least Concern with an unknown population trend.

HKBWS Oriental Pratincole page read as the contrast species: 23-25 cm, olive-brown above with dark uniform wings, buff head/mantle/chest, white belly, short bill with a red base and wide gape, and a black line running down from the eye to encircle the buff throat; common in spring in Hong Kong.
Hong Kong List 2024: 灰燕鴴 Glareola lactea is number 97, Category I, with no IUCN code (i.e. Least Concern); 普通燕鴴 Glareola maldivarum is number 96.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對深紅色嘴基、眼後最寬的白色眼圈、深灰初級飛羽與純白下腹。
全身圖沿用 0176 已核對的比較鳥（`0176/small-pratincole.png` 升格為主圖，本卡重新核對白眼圈、深灰初級飛羽與純白下腹），近景圖本卡新繪；兩張卡的淡灰沙色調一致。
比較鳥：普通燕鴴與黑翅燕鴴都沿用 0176 已核對的圖（`oriental-pratincole.png` = `0176/pixel.png`、`black-winged-pratincole.png` 原檔），非等比例；0176 與 0177 互相把對方當比較鳥，形成一組對照。
app 分數：i 2／v 3.7／r 4.8／c 1.2／o 2.9，另有 `vEst: 1`；**適應力 a 缺值**，卡面顯示「待查」，沒有補零或重算綜合 2.9。
IUCN 無危 LC、趨勢未知；香港屬 Category I 的**偶見鳥**，至今只有 2017-04-04 新田魚塘一筆紀錄（Lee 2019《香港鳥類報告 2017》）。全球無危與香港僅一筆要強調分開，不能寫成香港可見的過境鳥。
notes 寫明：本種是燕鴴裡最小、最淡的一種，飛行時翼下覆羽黑色、次級飛羽白而帶寬灰端、尾黑色——這些要在飛行中才看得清，卡面只放靜態站姿。
卡片上的 `cardDetails.zh.json` 說「胸呈褐灰色、腹白」大致無誤，但沒有提到白眼圈與深灰初級飛羽這兩個真正的野外重點，故以 HKBWS 頁面為準寫入四部位。
地圖為 Natural Earth 110m 世界底圖的國家層級概述，不是精確分佈多邊形；南亞為核心，向東延伸至華南與中南半島（HKG 與 SGP 不在 110m 底圖，未使用）。
